notes:
Replication statistics are author-derived primary project-table values, preserved without conversion. No effect-specific narrative replication verdict located; numeric success indicators are not treated as narrative verdicts. Original-source rule applied: replication project citations/quoted original statistics were not substituted for original primary evidence. DOI landing 403; OpenAlex lists no OA PDF; author-upload ResearchGate 403; title searches found no accessible full primary paper.
Source follow-up: Published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service; title, authors, year and DOI verified in supplied text. Only original target examined. Statistics are printed correlations with positively scored rule-abiding conduct, not sign-converted correlations with antisocial behavior. Page 1170 states: “the conduct composite was scored in the opposite direction (ranging from poor to good conduct)”. The p value and r refer to the same concurrent Conduct cell. Target match remains unknown because the neutral description and p.7 locator do not explicitly select concurrent versus childhood conduct. Table 4 separately prints Negative Emotionality/childhood Conduct −.21**; the supplied locator does not explicitly disambiguate that longitudinal association from the extracted concurrent association.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Printed observed effect .06, corrected effect .07 retained in notes. Generic printed metric retained; r versus standardized coefficient is not independently distinguishable per row. No metric or sign conversion.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly label column replication success rate, observed/corrected 100/100. Observed author summary mapped to successful; corrected summary retained in notes. No new significance-based verdict.
